scope: D19 behavioral gap fixes CA-01..CA-06 (composer gating, pairing entry, first Files open, non-Git review, task-actions menu, idle composer) plus packaged-app rebuild
implemented: CA-01 composer gating honesty: composer-runtime.ts now resolves structured model readiness (ready / not_selected / unavailable) plus modelReason, requires readiness==='ready' for dispatch, exposes action-specific reasons for Queue/Steer/Stop, and the webview renders the initial composer inert until the first authoritative snapshot; every disabled control carries title + aria-label reasons (apps/macos/src/composer-runtime.ts, apps/macos/src/webview.ts)

CA-02 pairing no longer dead-ends: the pairing command surfaces host-unavailable / unsupported / failure through an actionable notification pointing at the host settings or Caret Settings -> Devices; the native caret.host* setting descriptions no longer read as the iPhone connection flow; the Devices section keeps the explicit pairing CTA (apps/macos/src/extension.ts, apps/macos/package.json, apps/macos/src/webview.ts)

CA-03 first Files open: resolveStartupView() makes a pending native destination authoritative at activation, so a persisted 'explorer' destination consumes before the remembered Agents mode and the first Files action lands in the IDE with Explorer; Agents/IDE stays a presentation switch with no new OMP session (apps/macos/src/workbench-mode.ts, apps/macos/src/extension.ts)

CA-04 non-Git review routing: verified correct in source (ideLandingForWorkTab + REVIEW_NO_GIT_REASON, no SCM fallback) and pinned with a regression test instead of rewriting (apps/macos/test/extension-honesty.test.ts)

CA-05 deterministic task-actions menu: explicit taskActionsOpen/taskActionsTrigger state, state preserved across re-render, first enabled item focused on open, every close path (item, Escape, click-away, route change) updates aria-expanded and returns focus, and an empty action list renders a readable explanation row with its own style (apps/macos/src/webview.ts)

CA-06 idle composer: the control row is non-wrapping with an overflow policy, the shortcut hint drops before it displaces controls, and idle renders only model + thinking + primary Send (apps/macos/src/webview.ts)

verified.tests: 474 pass / 0 fail / 2636 assertions (bun run test, 71 files)
verified.packagedBundle: the packaged app carries the fixes: out/extension.js contains the nowrap composer bar, the .menu-empty rule, the taskActionsOpen state machine, the structured modelReadiness and resolveStartupView
verified.packagedLive: rebuilt and launched as an isolated fixture (empty window): the idle composer renders one row with only + / Model / Thinking and a disabled Send while the host reports no model, and no Follow up or shortcut hint appears — CA-06 verified live, CA-01 gating visible
